description: Midwest (grid model data) is a grid model dataset listed in Awesome Grid Model Data, a curated list of electricity grid model datasets under the section "MATPOWER (`.m`) > Texas A&M University (TAMU) Synthetic Grids > EPIGRIDS Cases", published or maintained by EPIGRIDS Cases. 10,192-bus synthetic grid. Coverage: the power system named in the entry. The list files it under EPIGRIDS Cases and gives it in MATPOWER format, with 1 link. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated in the list entry (source page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support power-flow, dynamic-stability and production-cost model studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-awesome-grid-model-data.
